description.default: Four members are running to chair the cooperative's board. Rank all four, from 1 for your first choice to 4 for your last; the lowest total wins. Membership is recorded on-chain, and members who join while the vote is open can take part.

title.default: How do you rank the candidates for chair?

description.default: Give each candidate a different rank, from 1 (first choice) to 4.
